appearances.whereabouts: Starts in hallway outside room where Egwene is being tortured, flees to the street, meets Nynaeve and Elayne, goes with them to the Three Plum Blossoms inn to meet Domon
appearances.notable_actions: Runs from Egwene's screams in tears; meets Nynaeve and Elayne on the street; warns them about the danger of damane; takes them to meet Captain Domon; explains the situation with Egwene; participates in negotiating passage on Domon's ship
appearances.demeanor: Distraught, weeping, feeling helpless and cowardly at the start; becomes hopeful when reunited with friends; anxious during negotiations with Domon

appearances.whereabouts: In a room in a Seanchan building being tortured/trained as a damane
appearances.notable_actions: Screams while being tortured or trained; mentioned as having ability to find ore which makes her valuable to the Seanchan; will be sent back to Seanchan mainland in a few days

appearances.whereabouts: Walking the streets of Falme with Elayne, then meeting Min, then going to the Three Plum Blossoms inn
appearances.notable_actions: Meets Min on the street; suggests getting a ship to escape; negotiates with Captain Domon; reveals her Serpent ring to prove she is of the White Tower; takes charge of planning the escape; shows confidence and determination throughout
appearances.demeanor: Initially worried but trying to hide it; becomes purposeful and confident when taking charge; shows nervousness only momentarily when dealing with Domon

appearances.whereabouts: Walking the streets of Falme with Nynaeve, then meeting Min, then going to the Three Plum Blossoms inn
appearances.notable_actions: Travels with Nynaeve; meets Min; participates in meeting with Domon; wishes Rand were present; comments on Nynaeve's risk-taking; reacts defensively when Domon treats her as a child
appearances.demeanor: Worried initially; hopeful after meeting Min; becomes indignant when treated as a child by Domon

appearances.whereabouts: At his usual table in the corner of the Three Plum Blossoms inn common room
appearances.notable_actions: Drinks wine while waiting; meets with Min and her friends; tells the story of witnessing Ryma's capture; initially reluctant but eventually agrees to provide passage and be ready to sail on short notice; warns the women about the dangers they face
appearances.demeanor: Gloomy and frustrated about his situation with Turak; wary and cautious when discussing escape plans; becomes more hopeful but still anxious when Nynaeve shows her Serpent ring

appearances.whereabouts: Not present; mentioned as being elsewhere in Falme, summoning Domon periodically

appearances.demeanor: Not present, but described as appearing soft while actually being hard and coldhearted

appearances.demeanor: Not directly shown in this chapter; described in past events as initially confident then horrified when cut off from the Source
